name: Roe AI
tagline: AI agents that investigate fraud, disputes, and AML cases end-to-end.
description: Roe AI is an agentic investigation platform for financial-crime teams. Its agents read structured and unstructured data from existing systems, follow a team's standard operating procedures, and produce cited, examiner-ready dispositions for fraud, chargeback dispute, and AML cases. It is used by card issuers, BNPL providers, marketplaces, and crypto compliance teams.
insight: Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient Ventures; pivoted from a general unstructured-data query engine to fraud and AML investigation.
edge: Produces cited, examiner-ready dispositions by following each team's own SOPs, rather than just flagging or scoring transactions.
pros: Built for fraud, disputes, and AML
